notes.title: UNSTABLE Leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
UNSTABLE has officially left Early Access!

[previewyoutube=rjU5vy2CXB4;full][/previewyoutube]

UNSTABLE is a 3D action runner with spaceship flight simulation. Handle unique keyboard controls to avoid asteroids! Disintegrate obstacles with a plasma laser weapon! Beat Leaderboard! And get to the mysterious unknown! Will you master the chaos of an unstable spaceship?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1821410/UNSTABLE/

UNSTABLE launched into early access almost two months ago (with a small break :)). At that time, there were only flat space and campaign levels. Since there several key things were added:

3 Gorgeous Maps
The space is enormous - fly as long as you can and meet various gorgeous spacescapes along your way.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/cc7f17db1641f20688b81853be55cd129ddb6b47.gif

Endless mode with Leaderboard
Try your best on your way to the best pilots!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/37a30f5de98de667587acc0b66f0438db4aa17dd.png

Juicy Flight Effects
Experience the game with dynamic effects & lighting!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/f23468b6b4e012cba56c325ba897dcb7d639ddc5.gif

Immersive Main Menu
Look around and interact directly with screens, gauges, and other equipment of the spaceship cockpit.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/6f4af59cda68c1e89622b93f6ccdaab6c7a73cb1.gif

Localization into 10 languages
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/ed7289eefc91e1423d73c36dd16c0ebca74aa0f3.png

Windows & Linux versions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/6ecb0cd59338b9d3ce3d8b9a9181dd2f2cab3e80.png

Steam Achievements & Cloud saves support
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/ab3a04dfb7552182b93be9efdc95ac3cd64a2dab.png

I'm very amazed at how this experiment turned out. Big thanks to people in Reddit communities for their positive, supportive, constructive feedback. I wouldn't last without you!

Also, check out the list of changes:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1821410/view/3110302192893902998

notes.title: 1.0.0 - list of changes
notes.content:
Added new labels and animations in main menu
 Added information of objects in pause menu
 Added variations of SFX
 Controls and level balances tweaked
 Several bugs with collisions fixed

notes.title: 0.6.1.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Bugs with leaderboard and interface were fixed
 Manual controls slightly tweaked

notes.title: 0.6.1.1 - Hotfix
notes.content: Bugs with level loading were fixed

notes.title: 0.6.1 - Improvements and Fixes
notes.content:
Added new visual effects in the main menu ("Play" variations, "Quit" animation, knobs, switches...)
 Several bugs with the leaderboard and music were fixed

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Redesigned Menu | Endless Mode | Leaderboard
notes.content:
Redesigned Main Menu
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/6f4af59cda68c1e89622b93f6ccdaab6c7a73cb1.gif
Look around and interact directly with screens, gauges, and other equipment of the spaceship cockpit. Try yourself!

New Endless Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/11c6e23d3cc10c43f786e3e7c9767014270e4e55.png
The space is endless, so is this mode. Default and Manual controls on your choice. How long will you thrive on flying through the obstacles?

Leaderboard
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/37a30f5de98de667587acc0b66f0438db4aa17dd.png
Try your best on your way to the best pilots!

In addition to these changes, the scope was slightly increased, and some bugs were fixed.

There will be a few more minor patches in the coming weeks before the full release. Balance improvements, new visual effects, bug fixes are coming.

notes.title: 0.5.2 - Tweaks and Fixes
notes.content:
Several bugs were fixed
 The main menu background changed
 Ship control slightly tweaked

notes.title: 0.5.1 - Balance Tweaking | More Effects
notes.content:
Level balance slightly tweaked
 Lines about slow-motion crystal added
 Death effects of spaceships added
 Shake effect during blast attack added
 Few bugs fixed

notes.title: 0.5.0 - Space Views | Slow Motion | New Effects
notes.content:
Space Views
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/0c383d7fa300ee4872b9dc8b55caa3b10e7e48d5.gif
The space is enormous, so you will meet various gorgeous spacescapes along your way.

Slow Motion
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/1147017bf5a064ef0d3201d2c4e55e6411dcb0e8.png
A new item appeared in the space. Catch it to boost your ship, so the time would look slowed in comparison with your speed for several seconds.

New Effects
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/f23468b6b4e012cba56c325ba897dcb7d639ddc5.gif
Experience the game with new effects & lighting

In addition to these changes, the keyboard impact was slightly tweaked, and some bugs were fixed.

Hope these things will increase your joyfulness of flying through space! The next big update will be in a few weeks. And its goal is to bring endless run mode with score and leaderboard.

notes.title: 0.4.1 - Russian Localization
notes.content:
All texts, images, menus are now also in Russian!
New languages are coming! If you're native and want to help with the translation, feel free to contact me (ex. discussion forum)

Changelog:

 Russian localization added
 Text on the table now appears at one position without moving
 Pause menu display fixed

notes.title: Early Access Release 🥳 | 0.4.0 - Steam Integration
notes.content:
Hello! I'm excited to announce that the upgraded game from Brackeys Game Jam 2021.2 (yeah, the idea has gone too far...) is released as early access now!

[previewyoutube=f7mFYKoGs9M;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1821410/UNSTABLE/

v0.4.0:

 Slight improvement of the tutorial
